note: List prices for AWS us-east-1 as published in AWS's Price List API (the files behind the pricing pages), read on the date checked. They are inputs: replace them with your provider's or your contract's and the model follows. GB and TB are decimal here (10^9 and 10^12 bytes). AWS: if a price list file and a service pricing page differ, AWS charges the pricing page's price.

storage_gb_month.sku: Amazon S3 Standard storage, first 50 TB per month (TimedStorage-ByteHrs)

request_get.sku: Amazon S3 GET and all other requests (Requests-Tier2: USD 0.004 per 10,000); DELETE is free

request_put.sku: Amazon S3 PUT, COPY, POST or LIST requests (Requests-Tier1: USD 0.005 per 1,000)

scan_tb.sku: Amazon Athena data scanned (DataScannedInTB), 10 MB minimum per query
